name: Lineup

components.pose: She stands tall and square to the camera, feet a little apart, one arm relaxed slightly away from her side and the other palm held open at waist height, chin level, a calm, commanding gaze straight to the camera; her full figure from head to toe is visible, centred, filling the frame height with space on all sides; every magical effect stays within arm's reach of her body so she can be cut out cleanly.
components.jewelry: a {{METAL}} coil collar with {{GEM}} stones, long spark earrings, {{METAL}} armlets
components.effects: Thin arcs of white-hot lightning crackle around her hands and hem, a spark ball glows in her palm, static lifts a few strands of her hair.

notes: GROUP SHOT cut-out: her dawn regalia on a flat grey backdrop with the shared dawn lighting, full figure, effects kept close, to be composited with the other nine. See docs/art/tutorial-art.md (group shots).
